The monsoon in Mumbai is fast approaching, and this is your final chance to prevent water leakage, seepage, damp walls, and structural damage. Don’t wait for heavy rains to expose weak points—act before the damage begins.

Start by treating all visible cracks with high-quality waterproof sealants and crack repair tapes. Even hairline cracks can lead to major leakage during intense rainfall. Inspect external walls with moss, dampness, or water absorption issues—these are clear signs your building needs exterior waterproofing treatment.

Pay special attention to joints, corners, window edges, and slab junctions—these are the most common rainwater infiltration points. Proper sealing ensures long-term protection against seepage.

Check for loose, damaged, or hollow plaster and repair it immediately to avoid water penetration and costly repairs later. Most importantly, ensure your terrace waterproofing system and rainwater drain pipes are clean and unclogged to prevent water accumulation and overflow.

SAFE WATER-TANK WATERPROOFING – Choosing the Right Product

Ensuring safe and hygienic water storage begins with the right waterproofing system. Water tanks are constantly exposed to moisture, pressure, and chemical interactions, making protection essential. This is where 2-component (2K) cementitious waterproofing coatings prove to be a game changer.

A 2K system combines a polymer liquid with a cement-based powder to form a highly flexible, durable, and watertight membrane. Once applied, it creates a seamless barrier that bonds strongly with concrete surfaces, preventing leakage, seepage, and contamination. Unlike traditional coatings, these systems are non-toxic, potable water safe, and resistant to cracks, ensuring long-term performance.

At KWICK FIX SOLUTIONS, we emphasize selecting the right waterproofing solution tailored for water tanks—prioritizing safety, adhesion, and durability. Our solutions are designed to withstand hydrostatic pressure while maintaining the purity of stored water.

APP Membrane Waterproofing is a proven solution for wooden heritage roofs and old buildings, offering long-lasting protection without compromising structural integrity.

APP (Atactic Polypropylene) modified bitumen membranes provide excellent waterproofing, flexibility, and crack-bridging properties, making them ideal for aged substrates. On wooden roofs, where movement and thermal expansion are common, APP membranes accommodate slight shifts without failure. Their strong adhesion ensures a seamless barrier against heavy monsoon rains, seepage, and dampness, which are major concerns in coastal climates.

To further enhance performance, applying a Silver Protective Coating over APP membranes significantly improves UV resistance and heat reflectivity. For restoration projects, heritage buildings, and coastal waterproofing challenges, APP membranes offer a cost-effective, reliable, and long-term solution.
